posts.title: Weeks 398 & 399
posts.description: The train from Liverpool. A Mancunian or someone must have stuck their used chewing gum on an armrest or similar, and I didn’t notice until it was all over my winter coat. Thanks a lot, East Midlands Railway. Halloween. Saw what I thought was the Ku Klux Klan, but on closer inspection was some people dressed as traffic cones (or the VLC logo). posts.description: After years of a using a temporary cardboard desk (something like this but bigger), I got a proper one made of wood and metal.
